sentences.en: The implications of this did not at first sink in.
sentences.zh: 一开始，我们并没有意识到这一点的含意。

sentences.en: The societal implications of this research are likely to be far-reaching.
sentences.zh: 这项研究的社会影响可能会非常深远。

sentences.en: Please stop finding horrifying implications in my cutaway jokes.
sentences.zh: 请别在我的讽刺笑话中找寻恐怖的暗示了。
